_comment: Uncork protonfixes-for-Mac database. One source of truth for per-game fixes, read by scripts/autoconfigure.sh (applies fixes), scripts/play.sh (launch exe/env/args/HUD), and the app (GameCompat verdicts). Data-driven so it updates without rebuilding the app. Seeded from Metal testing (ProtonDB is a hint, not gospel: Metal is not Vulkan). Modeled on Proton's protonfixes.
_schema_fields: Per game: title, engine, backend, verdict(works|needs-work|unsupported|untested), launch_exe (relative), winetricks[] (runtime verbs), env{} (extra env vars, e.g. {"MTL_HUD_ENABLED":"1"}), launch_args (string appended to the exe), hud (bool: default Metal perf HUD), anticheat (string: name the anti-cheat tech, e.g. "Easy Anti-Cheat"/"BattlEye"/"kernel-level"; presence shows a clear "won't run online on Apple Silicon" warning on the game page, since EAC/BattlEye have no macOS runtime; pair with verdict "unsupported"), drm (bool: force/disable the Steam-DRM launch path; when unset, play.sh auto-detects SteamStub. true launches through the Steam client via -applaunch, false always direct-launches), isolated_prefix (bool: give this game its own bottle, for titles whose winetricks/winver tweaks would disturb the shared bottle), notes. Per-user toggles (e.g. HUD on/off) live in the app's overrides.json and win over the DB.

1172470.title: Apex Legends
1172470.notes: Online multiplayer requires Easy Anti-Cheat, which has no macOS runtime, so it cannot run on Apple Silicon. Not a graphics limitation; the anti-cheat blocks launch.

252490.title: Rust
252490.notes: Requires Easy Anti-Cheat for all servers; EAC has no macOS runtime, so the game will not run on Apple Silicon.

359550.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
359550.notes: Uses BattlEye anti-cheat, which has no macOS runtime, so it cannot run on Apple Silicon.

227300.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2
227300.notes: Force the DirectX 11 renderer with -rdevice dx11 so the game draws through D3DMetal. Its default/OpenGL path fails under Wine on macOS with 'no valid graphics device was found' (seen on M1). Confirmed working on Apple Silicon with this flag. If it still errors, delete config.cfg in the game's Documents folder (it can cache a bad renderer) and relaunch.

312990.title: The Expendabros
312990.notes: Hardest case on Apple Silicon: 32-bit + Direct3D 9. (1) D3DMetal is D3D10-12 only and DXMT is D3D11 only, so neither handles D3D9. (2) wined3d D3D9-to-OpenGL crashes on macOS 26 (GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION + alloc_pages_vprot assert). (3) DXVK d3d9-to-Vulkan is blocked by the geometryShader wall: DXVK v3.0.1 and v1.10.3 both require the Vulkan geometryShader feature, which MoltenVK cannot provide (Metal has no geometry shaders), giving 'No adapters found' then DxvkError. The exe is 32-bit so DXVK needs x32 DLLs (play.sh auto-detects). -force-d3d11 is ignored: Unity 4 has no D3D11 path and falls to OpenGL 2.1 (winemac GL over Metal), which fails ARB shader compile (InternalErrorShader, crash). 32-bit DXMT: only a mismatched dxmt-v0.80 exists (the working 64-bit DXMT is a local build with an incompatible winemetal.so, cannot mix); a uniform swap to v0.80 still hits the OpenGL fallback since -force-d3d11 does not apply. Possible paths forward (all unbuilt): d3d9on12-to-D3DMetal chain, a geometryShader-relaxed DXVK build, or a matched 32-bit DXMT. Not representative: 64-bit D3D11/12 titles work via DXMT/D3DMetal (RISK, Euro Truck confirmed). Also shows no window on Linux/Proton, so the game itself is broken, not a Mac/Uncork limitation. General rule: Linux/Proton is the floor, if a game fails there it will not work on Mac (strictly harder); check ProtonDB before investing.

945360.title: Among Us
945360.notes: 32-bit Unity. Reaches main menu on the 32-bit DXMT build. REQUIRES -force-d3d11-no-singlethreaded: without it Unity's multithreaded D3D11 device creation spins on DXMT (100% CPU, stuck at 'GfxDevice: creating device client', no window). -screen-fullscreen 0 keeps it windowed for a reliable first-run. Earlier 'could not load d3d11.dll (80029c4a)' was not a DXMT crash: no i386 DXMT existed and a stale DXVK-era 'native' registry override forced a non-builtin d3d11. Fixed by the i386 DXMT build + the DXMT path clearing stale native overrides + forcing d3d11/dxgi/d3d10core=builtin in play.sh.

960090.title: Bloons TD 6
960090.notes: Unity D3D11 -> DXMT/Metal at feature level 11.1. Verified reaches menu. (DXMT lacks ID3D11Fence -> one harmless 0x80004005, falls back.)

1128810.title: RISK: Global Domination
1128810.notes: Unity D3D11 -> DXMT. Requires the leftover wined3d/DXVK d3d dlls to be stripped from system32/syswow64 (autoconfigure does this) so the 'native' override falls through to the DXMT builtin.

359870.title: FINAL FANTASY FFX/FFX-2 HD Remaster
359870.notes: .NET/WPF launcher fails on Wine-Mono ('fatal error in the mono runtime'); needs real .NET 4.0 (dotnet40 is enough; dotnet48 not required). IMPORTANT: the winetricks .NET install spins forever in ngen/mscorsvw on Wine -> the installer must cap/kill mscorsvw (see autoconfigure ngen handling). Launch via the launcher, then pick FFX or FFX-2.

355790.title: Styx: Shards of Darkness
355790.notes: UE4 4.13, feature level 11 + GEOMETRY SHADERS. Works on Proton because Vulkan has geometry shaders; Metal does not, so DXMT must emulate them (or use D3DMetal). Launch the Win64 shipping exe directly, not the Styx2.exe launcher. Not yet working on Metal.
